title: On Checking the lock on every door
subtitle: 数据统计 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）
meta: 主题语境：数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）　|　核心词汇：check　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 check 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 the elder ① checked the lock on every door in silence, and every youth in the village said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the elder ② checks the lock on every door twice over without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ check the lock on every door at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ checked the lock on every door before — a line in the memoir for November 1962 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Checking the lock on every door in silence, the elder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the staff at the far gate, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ check the figures against the old list twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Check the figures against the old list at once and never mention it again.

By 1975 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the memoir, and a new youth from the next village ⑧ checks the figures against the old list in silence every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the gate, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ checked the lock on every door again when nobody else would.

⑩ To check the lock on every door, my mother said in 1980, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the village remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the village forgets, somebody checks the lock on every door twice over again and somebody must check the lock on every door in silence all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 检查（一般过去式 checked the lock on every door：1968 年长者头一回这样做，一言不发地）
B. v. 检查（一般现在 checks the lock on every door：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 检查（不定式 to check the lock on every door：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 检查（过去完成时 had checked the lock on every door：1962 年十一月的回忆录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 检查（动名词 checking the lock on every door 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 核实（check the figures against the old list：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去核实拿那些数目与旧单核对）
G. v. 核实（check the figures against the old list：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 检查（后段两处：新来的后生照例 checks the figures against the old list，而母亲又一次 checked the lock on every door）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 check 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1968 the elder checked the lock on every door in silence, and nobody in the village forgot it.
Even now the elder checks the lock on every door twice over whenever the village asks.
Checking the lock on every door in silence, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever check the figures against the old list twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new youth from the next village checks the figures against the old list in silence every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother checked the lock on every door again, and the village remembered that half.
